newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing North Star, HK$1.2bln float - source.
newsitem.headline: Beijing North Star, HK$1.2bln float - source.

text.p: Chinese property development and investment concern Beijing North Star Co Ltd is expected to raise HK$1.2 billion to HK$1.4 billion through an H-share listing in Hong Kong, market sources said on Wednesday.
Sources said the company is expected to issue 615 million H-shares at a price ranging HK$1.99 to HK$2.32 each.
The net proceeds to be raised is expected to be used to improve assets quality and to cut debt, they said.

Sources said Beijing North Star's net asset value (NAV) per share was expected to be about 3.01 yuan, putting the issue price at about 28.6 percent discount to NAV if the price was being fixed at the mid-range of about 2.15 yuan.
Beijing North Star has property development and investment portfolio. Substantial portion of the investment portfolio is in the Asian Games Village in Beijing, they said.
HSBC Investment Bank is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, sources said.
The company is expected to hold a company presentation for analysts on Friday, they said.
